title: Suffix inventory
description: Suffixes in archiphoneme notation. No surface allomorph may appear here.

surface.description: Archiphoneme notation: -(y)I, -DAn, -lAr. Empty string for a zero marker. Ø in the optional slot is a different zero: it means this suffix deletes the stem's own final vowel before attaching (-(Ø)Iyor), rather than inserting a buffer. Character classes rather than escapes, so the pattern survives a round trip through any tooling.

cannot_follow.description: Suffix ids this one may not follow. The engine refuses the sequence rather than generating a form no speaker would produce.

has_fixed_vowel.description: This suffix contains a vowel that does not harmonize, such as the o of -Iyor or the i of -ki. Required to write a literal vowel in `surface`; without it, a literal vowel is an allomorph leak.
